context.stage: Stage F1 - Application Shell and Authentication

task.description: Validate the design artefact at src/design/shell-f1.md for Stage F1 SH-01 through SH-04. Verify: (1) every acceptance criterion in every MUST requirement has a design element, (2) no implementation code is present, (3) all public function/component signatures are listed, (4) error taxonomy exists, (5) security notes on token storage. FAIL if any check fails. On PASS set next_action to Route to FRONTEND-DEV (Step 02).
acceptance_criteria: SH-01 login flow fully designed (token input, health check validation, JWT decode)
SH-04 user indicator (display_name + roles + logout) designed
No implementation code in the design file

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/shell-f1.md passes all 8 checks. SH-01: token input (login-token-input), GET /health/ready validation, decodeTokenPayload algorithm, and 6-entry error taxonomy all present. SH-02: in-memory module-level storage documented (section 7), session-expired redirect via auth:session-expired event and /login?reason=session-expired with login-session-expired banner documented; OC-01 in section 11 documents FNFR-06 partial compliance with full rationale and deferred-persistence path. SH-03: 4-role nav matrix (11 items x 4 roles) present in section 5; hidden-not-disabled rule explicitly stated. SH-04: display_name (user-display-name), roles (user-roles), and logout-button designed in section 9. No implementation code: all code blocks labeled design-only, no function bodies. All public signatures listed: decodeTokenPayload, resolveDisplayName, getToken/setToken/clearToken, login, logout, LoginPage, AppShell, plus JwtPayload/UserSession/AuthContextValue interfaces. Error taxonomy: 6-entry table in section 8. Security/FNFR-06: section 10 notes + OC-01 in section 11.
